_comment: Source of truth for sage-tools-api's sync registry — fetched at runtime by SyncConfigStore, cached for SYNC_CONFIG_TTL_MS (default ~1 minute). See README.md in this folder for the shape/validation rules before editing by hand.

bkl-cup-2026._comment: Ended Aug 2026. Once GITHUB_REPO points at the shared event-data repo, a resync of any of these days publishes to event-data/bkl-cup-2026/data/..., which is NOT where the archived bkl-cup-2026 pages on the site read from — their live data simply stops updating. Harmless (nothing triggers a resync of a finished event), but that's why: don't treat a 'stale' archived bkl page as a bug, and don't re-point GITHUB_REPO back to fix it.

day2._comment: SCHEDULE CHANGE: Day 1 (Aug 14) was cancelled — the event ran Aug 15-16 and 21-23 instead. These entries keep their original day2-day6 keys (so already-published data and each facility spreadsheet's DAY_KEY didn't need to change) — only the user-facing label was renumbered.
